subject: Questionnaire kickoff — clarifying data residency, SOC 2 status, and evidence owners
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@medwell.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Questionnaire kickoff — clarifying data residency, SOC 2 status, and evidence owners

Hi Alicia,

Thanks again for the call this morning — good to meet you and the MedWell security team.  Quick recap and a few clarifying asks so we can kick off the vendor questionnaire efficiently: 

- SOC 2: you mentioned an audit is in progress. Can you confirm whether it will be Type I or Type II, and the expected completion window? If you have a SOC document we can reference (even a summary), please share.
- Data residency: on the call you referenced multi-region hosting. Please confirm whether MedWell requires EU data residency for any customer data or if US-only (us-east-1) is acceptable for initial deployment.
- Questionnaire preference: do you want us to start with SIG, CAIQ, or a custom form? If SIG is fine we can prefill a number of fields and surface outstanding evidence asks.
- Evidence owners: please identify the point people for infra/ops, security (controls), and privacy/legal so we can route evidence requests directly.

Proposed next steps:
1) I’ll attach a short SIG prefill template and a suggested evidence owner matrix — please populate the owners you want us to contact.
2) If you’d like a short handoff session with our security engineer (Karthik) and your infra lead, we can schedule a 30-minute follow-up.
3) We’ll return a prefilled SIG sheet within ~7–10 business days and call out any gaps.

Attachments: Redwood SIG prefill guide (see linked sheet) — I’ll follow up with the prefill template right after this.

If anything above is off, tell me and I’ll update. Otherwise if you can confirm SOC 2 type/timing and residency preference, we’ll start routing asks.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
